decision.title: Frankie and Johnny
tracklist: Down by the Riverside / When the Saints Go Marching In

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/12945493-Elvis-Presley-Frankie-And-Johnny, https://www.shugarecords.com/products/elvis-presley-frankie-and-johnny-vg-lp-record. Original LP RCA Victor LPM/LSP 3553 (Mar 1966), 12 tracks. Track 8 is the two-song medley 'Down by the Riverside / When the Saints Go Marching In'. Note: Pickwick's 1976 budget reissue retitled 'Frankie & Johnny' omitted 3 songs — that is NOT the original; use this 12-track original.
